name: Chicken Qorma
description: Traditional Pakistani chicken qorma with yogurt, deeply fried onions and aromatic whole spices.
ingredients: ½–1 cup hot water, as needed
method: Heat oil in a heavy pot and fry the onions until deep golden. Remove them, drain briefly and crush when cool.
In the same oil add the whole spices, ginger-garlic paste and chicken. Fry over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes until the chicken changes colour and lightly browns.
Lower the heat and add red chili, coriander powder and salt. Add the whisked yogurt gradually while stirring.
Return most of the crushed fried onion to the pot and cook the masala thoroughly until it thickens and oil begins to separate.
Add a little hot water, cover and simmer gently until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.
Finish with garam masala. Adjust the gravy with a little hot water if needed, garnish with the reserved fried onion and serve hot.
tips: Fry the onions evenly golden rather than dark brown, as burnt onions can make qorma bitter.
Add yogurt gradually over lower heat and cook the masala well for a smooth, rich gravy.
storage: Cool promptly and refrigerate covered for up to 2 days. Reheat until piping hot throughout.
